name: Kondou Mari
source: A third-year student who is the student council president of another school. She often makes visits to [url=/c68296]Kouichi's[/url] school due to her position. Mari is a girl with both dignified and refined appearance and personality, who however tends to compare herself with others, and feels completely inferior to [url=/c38072]Senka[/url]. She also has some kind of family problems surrounding her.
